answer: Each agent identity is bound to a nonce-chained work history: every task signs the hash of the previous task plus a fresh nonce, and peers reject forks of that single chain. Copies cannot split a reputation that only grows along one linear thread. To fake identities an attacker must re-earn each history from zero, paying real compute and time per copy, exposed the moment chains diverge - a sparrow's lone flight past a vertex and down the canyon, one unbroken path, one identity.
